scenarios.expected: Write supported what/where/why; omit unsupported Where and Why; omit API section entirely

scenarios.input: Endpoint addition, deletion, or method/path change
scenarios.expected: One Method+Path row per affected pair; method/path change is Removed old pair then New pair

scenarios.input: Request/response/auth/status change; auth/schema-only diff tied to unchanged route definition
scenarios.expected: Changed rows only for route-bound contract changes; route line need not change

scenarios.input: Removed, Changed, New routes with hosts, tokens, query values in source
scenarios.expected: Rows ordered Removed, Changed, New; retain code path parameters; exclude hosts, tokens, query values

required: [Feature list: what / where / why per item — see references/pr-body-features-api.md]
**Feature list and API table**
On the existing-PR update path, Step 7 and this reference remain skipped.
**What** is phrased as a capability or behavior, not a file name.

If the
  diff shows no location, omit the Where line

If
  no source states the reason, omit the Why line.
Group pure internal changes

Never reorder or
  remove the template's own sections.
the route line itself may be unchanged
no empty heading, no "N/A"
List Removed rows first, then Changed, then New
A handler-internal change that keeps the contract is not a row.

Never
  include hosts, tokens, or query values.
A method/path change is a Removed row for the old pair and a New row for the new pair.

Placement: append after the Impact section (or after the template/default body and any Design
Background when Impact is omitted).
